name: ENN Natural Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: ENN Natural Gas Co., Ltd., headquartered in Langfang, China, since its establishment in 1992, is a comprehensive energy provider. The company's core business operations in China encompass the wholesale and retail distribution of natural gas, alongside engaging in energy chemical and general chemical trading, and the mining and washing of coal. Beyond commodity sales, ENN offers a broad spectrum of engineering services. These include design, equipment manufacturing, and construction and installation for natural gas infrastructure, novel chemical industries, and environmental protection initiatives. Additionally, it undertakes technology research and development, provides consulting, manages equipment integration, and executes project management. Its product portfolio extends to the production and sale of coal, methanol, and dimethyl ether, in addition to supplying bulk liquefied natural gas (LNG) and a diverse range of energy forms such as electricity, heating, cooling, and steam. The company serves a wide array of customers, distributing pipeline natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial users. For residential consumers, it also retails gas appliances, including stoves, water heaters, range hoods, and heating units. Industrial clients are further supplied with building materials and various other energy products. Known previously as ENN Ecological Holdings Co., Ltd., the company officially adopted its current name, ENN Natural Gas Co., Ltd., in October 2020.
